name: B10-0219/2024 (Verts/ALE) – 11th year of the occupation of the Autonomous Republic of Crimea and the city of Sevastopol by the Russian Federation and the deteriorating human rights situation in occupied Crimea, notably the cases of Iryna Danylovych, Tofik
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 11th year of the occupation of the Autonomous Republic of Crimea and the city of Sevastopol by the Russian Federation and the deteriorating human rights situation in occupied Crimea, notably the cases of Iryna Danylovych, Tofik Abdulhaziiev and Amet Suleymanov
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of three detained people in Russian-occupied Crimea: journalist Iryna Danylovych, activist Tofik Abdulhaziiev and journalist Amet Suleymanov. It says Russia holds over 218 people on political charges, many of them Crimean Tatars, and denies them medical care. It asks Russia to stop human rights abuses, withdraw from Ukraine, and let aid groups check on detainees. The text is a statement of position, not a law.

- Nothing changes yet; Parliament only states demands and asks Russia to act.
- The three named detainees and other held Ukrainians are affected.
- Next, the text goes to European Union bodies, Ukraine and aid groups.
